status: frozen 2026-11-05 before any union re-merge or re-test below
question: Does the conclusion that most of the paper's coop-solo gap is a merge artifact (68% closed for GPT-5, 85% for Claude) survive a conflict resolution weaker than gpt-6-luna, and scoring coop and solo with the same harness?
from_note: pairs, own-patch tests, merged re-tests and llm re-merges come from the paper census, the upstream check and the merge audit

levels.L1: no conflict resolution of ours: L0 plus failed pairs whose merge is clean in our harness and passes both features
levels.L2: union: L1 plus failed pairs whose real merge conflicts and that pass both features after git's union merge (keep both sides of every conflict block)
levels.L3: llm: L1 plus failed pairs whose real merge conflicts and that pass after the frozen gpt-6-luna re-merge (the merge audit's figure)

union: every failed pair whose real merge conflicts (the paper's recorded conflicts and the failed pairs it recorded as clean whose merge conflicts in our harness) is re-merged with the merge test's union method and tested on both features; Docker only

same_harness.sample: 150 random pairs per model among pairs with both a coop and a solo run, seed 20261105
same_harness.solo: the published solo patch tested on both features in our harness (CooperBench's test_solo)
same_harness.coop: every sampled pair scored in our harness: our merged re-test when our merge is clean; when it conflicts, failed at L1, the union re-merge at L2, the llm re-merge at L3. Pairs without our merge yet are merged and tested first, and re-merged if they conflict

measurements.gap: per model and level, the share of the coop-solo gap closed relative to L0, on all pairs with a solo run (solo as recorded) and on the sample (coop and solo in our harness)
measurements.solo_agreement: on the sample, recorded solo results against our re-test, and the net change in solo success

decision_rule: Primary, per model: the gap closed at L2 on all pairs with a solo run. At least a third: the merge-artifact conclusion holds without any LLM conflict resolution. Below a third: the conclusion depends on how conflicts are resolved and is reported as the range L1 to L3. Robustness: on the sample with coop and solo in our harness, if the L2 closure differs from the full-population L2 closure by more than 15 points, the same-harness figure is reported as the main one, because the recorded solo results would then be biased. Secondary: L1 and L3, and solo agreement.
results: sensitivity_rows.csv and sensitivity_summary.json in the output directory
